abstract: [Diagnostic and interventional radiology (Ankara, Turkey)] Growing evidence shows that medical imaging has a substantial environmental impact. With the increasing adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) in clinical settings, it is important to explore how this technology may support environmental sustainability. Literature searches were performed across eight databases (PubMed, Wiley Online Library, Embase, Web of Science platform, the Cochrane Library, Cumulative Index to Nursing and Allied Health Literature Ultimate, Google Scholar, and MedRxiv) for the period January 2020-June 2026. Full-text sources in the English language were eligible for inclusion. The Joanna Briggs Institute checklists were employed for risk of bias assessment. All data were analyzed using a textual narrative synthesis. In total, 23 studies were deemed eligible for inclusion. The literature proposed that AI tools in medical imaging could be used to minimize energy consumption by optimizing patient scheduling, decreasing scanner idle times and workstation use, reducing computed tomography over-scanning, contrast agent usage, and radiation dose, harnessing low-field magnetic resonance imaging, and curtailing low-value imaging. However, AI technologies may also impact the environment in harmful ways. Although AI-powered solutions hold promise for improving sustainability in medical imaging, the true environmental impact remains largely unexplored. The findings of this work further strengthen the dual role of AI adoption in medical imaging related to environmental sustainability.
zh_abstract: [土耳其安卡拉《诊断与介入放射学》] 越来越多的证据表明，医学影像对环境具有显著影响。随着人工智能（AI）在临床环境中的应用日益增多，探讨这一技术如何支持环境可持续性十分重要。我们在八个数据库（PubMed、Wiley Online Library、Embase、Web of Science 平台、Cochrane 图书馆、Cumulative Index to Nursing and Allied Health Literature Ultimate、Google Scholar 和 MedRxiv）中检索了2020年1月至2026年6月的文献。符合纳入条件的为英文全文来源。采用 Joanna Briggs Institute 清单进行偏倚风险评估。所有数据采用文字叙述性综合方法进行分析。共有23项研究被认定符合纳入标准。文献提出，医学影像中的AI工具可通过以下方式降低能耗：优化患者排程、减少扫描仪闲置时间和工作站使用、减少计算机断层扫描的过度扫描、减少对比剂用量和辐射剂量、利用低场磁共振成像，以及减少低价值影像检查。然而，AI技术也可能以有害方式影响环境。尽管基于AI的解决方案有望改善医学影像的可持续性，但其真实的环境影响在很大程度上仍未被探索。这项工作的发现进一步强化了医学影像中采用AI在环境可持续性方面所具有的双重作用。

title: Clinical quality of large language model responses to thyroid surgery questions: an expert comparative evaluation.
zh_title: 大语言模型回答甲状腺手术问题的临床质量：专家对比评估
summary: 五位甲状腺外科医生对ChatGPT、Gemini、Copilot及盲法人类专家在18个问题上的回答评分；各LLM中位数均为5分，均值略低于人类专家。
key_points: 18个问题，5位外科医生独立5分制评分
评分者间一致性ICC为0.36-0.66
reason: 小规模问答评估，仅18题，无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: [Updates in surgery] Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for medical information, but their reliability in thyroid surgery remains uncertain. Responses from ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, and a blinded human expert comparator were evaluated across 18 thyroid surgery-related clinical questions. Five experienced thyroid surgeons independently rated all responses using a 5-point Likert scale reflecting overall clinical quality. Inter-rater reliability was assessed using intraclass correlation coefficients (ICCs), and differences between LLMs were analyzed with non-parametric repeated-measures tests; each LLM was compared descriptively with the human comparator. Inter-rater agreement ranged from fair to moderate-good (ICC 0.36-0.66). All LLMs achieved high clinical quality scores (median 5), with means slightly below the human comparator (4.47-4.66 vs 4.80). No significant differences were detected among LLMs (Friedman test, p = 0.095), although a marked ceiling effect and question-level variability were observed. LLMs may support patient-facing thyroid surgery information, but specialist oversight remains essential.
zh_abstract: [Updates in surgery] 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地用于获取医学信息，但其在甲状腺外科领域的可靠性仍不确定。我们针对 18 个与甲状腺手术相关的临床问题，评估了 ChatGPT、Google Gemini、Microsoft Copilot 以及一位盲法的人类专家对照者的回答。五位经验丰富的甲状腺外科医生使用反映总体临床质量的 5 分 Likert 量表对所有回答进行独立评分。采用组内相关系数（ICC）评估评估者间信度，并使用非参数重复测量检验分析各 LLM 之间的差异；每个 LLM 与人类对照者进行描述性比较。评估者间一致性为一般至中等-良好（ICC 0.36-0.66）。所有 LLM 的临床质量评分均较高（中位数为 5），均值略低于人类对照者（4.47-4.66 对 4.80）。各 LLM 之间未检测到显著差异（Friedman 检验，p = 0.095），但观察到明显的天花板效应及问题层面的变异。LLM 可能有助于面向患者的甲状腺手术信息提供，但专科医生的监督仍然至关重要。

title: Analyzing Online Discourse of Retrograde Cricopharyngeal Dysfunction: A Human-Validated LLM Study.
source: PubMed · Otolaryngology--head and neck surgery : official journal of American Academy of Otolaryngology-Head and Neck Surgery
zh_title: 经人工验证的LLM分析逆行性环咽肌功能障碍线上讨论
summary: 研究用ChatGPT-5.2分析Reddit社区2014至2025年帖子，提取主题、症状与诊疗障碍，并以400帖人工标注子集验证。
key_points: 横断面观察性研究，来源r/NoBurp社区
400帖人工裁定作为参照标准
评估精确率、召回率、F1与kappa
reason: 社交媒体文本分析，单一社区，增量档
abstract: [Otolaryngology--head and neck surgery : official journal of American Academy of Otolaryngology-Head and Neck Surgery] Perform a human-validated large language model (LLM) analysis of an online Reddit community dedicated to retrograde cricopharyngeal dysfunction (R-CPD), characterizing common themes, symptoms, treatment experiences, and diagnostic barriers. Cross-sectional, observational analysis of patient-generated online discourse using LLM-based thematic classification validated against human adjudication. r/NoBurp, a public Reddit community dedicated to R-CPD. All posts from March 2014 to December 2025 were extracted and deduplicated. A 400-post subset was human-adjudicated to establish a reference standard for interrater comparison (precision, recall, F1 score, Cohen's kappa). All posts were analyzed with ChatGPT-5.2 for theme identification, temporal trends, symptoms frequency, and sentiment analysis. A bibliometric analysis compared annual R-CPD publication volume to annual Reddit post volume. 20,299 unique posts were analyzed. The five dominant themes were core symptom burden (56.5%), treatment experience (53.3%), healthcare navigation (26.0%), self-management (15.2%), and reflux-related symptoms (12.5%). Annual post volume rose sharply years before the major increase in R-CPD-related publications. Interrater agreement was high for botulinum toxin/procedural treatment (k = 0.70, 95% CI [0.64-0.77], F1 = 0.81), moderate for core symptom burden (k = 0.44, 95% CI [0.36-0.52], F1 = 0.77), and slight-to-fair for diagnostic journey/healthcare navigation (k = 0.22, 95% CI [0.15-0.29], F1 = 0.38). Patients experience prolonged diagnostic journeys marked by clinician unfamiliarity with R-CPD, often identifying their condition through online communities. Rising patient discourse preceded growth in the published literature, suggesting that r/NoBurp functioned not only as a support forum but also as an accelerator of R-CPD research.
zh_abstract: 对专注于逆行性环咽肌功能障碍（retrograde cricopharyngeal dysfunction，R-CPD）的在线 Reddit 社区进行经人工验证的大语言模型（LLM）分析，描述其常见主题、症状、治疗经历和诊断障碍。采用横断面观察性分析，对患者生成的在线讨论内容进行基于 LLM 的主题分类，并以人工裁定结果进行验证。研究对象为 r/NoBurp，一个专注于 R-CPD 的公开 Reddit 社区。提取 2014 年 3 月至 2025 年 12 月的所有帖子并去重。人工裁定其中 400 条帖子的子集，以建立评估者间比较的参考标准（精确率、召回率、F1 分数、Cohen's kappa）。使用 ChatGPT-5.2 对所有帖子进行主题识别、时间趋势、症状频率和情感分析。通过文献计量分析，将 R-CPD 年度发表量与 Reddit 年度发帖量进行比较。共分析 20,299 条不重复帖子。五个主要主题为：核心症状负担（56.5%）、治疗经历（53.3%）、医疗服务就医路径（26.0%）、自我管理（15.2%）和反流相关症状（12.5%）。年度发帖量在 R-CPD 相关文献大幅增加的数年前就已急剧上升。评估者间一致性方面，肉毒毒素/操作性治疗一致性高（k = 0.70，95% CI [0.64-0.77]，F1 = 0.81），核心症状负担为中等（k = 0.44，95% CI [0.36-0.52]，F1 = 0.77），诊断历程/医疗服务就医路径为轻微至一般（k = 0.22，95% CI [0.15-0.29]，F1 = 0.38）。患者经历了漫长的诊断历程，其特点是临床医生对 R-CPD 不熟悉，患者往往通过在线社区才认识到自己的病情。患者讨论的增长先于已发表文献的增长，提示 r/NoBurp 不仅是一个支持论坛，也起到了推动 R-CPD 研究的加速器作用。

title: Beyond Ground Truth: A Heuristic Unsupervised Quality Assurance Engine for Diagnosing Calibrational Blindness in Dental Segmentation
zh_title: 超越真值：诊断牙科分割“校准盲区”的无监督质控引擎
summary: 提出HUS-QA，在无真值掩码时评估牙科X线分割质量，针对模型置信度高但分割差的问题。
key_points: 基于PRAD数据与SimCLR预训练ResNet-18 U-Net
综合置信度、边缘锐度、连通性、面积惩罚
称标准置信度方法在该问题上失效
reason: 预印本，单数据集质控方法，证据有限
abstract: In real-world clinical settings, dental X-ray segmentation using deep learning methods suffers from reliability issues. Even when the segmentation quality is bad, deep learning models show high confidence in their predictions (calibrational blindness). Moreover, in real use, doctors do not have ground-truth masks to check their accuracy. To address this problem, we introduce a simple quality-checking engine called HUS-QA with three stages. We train it on the PRAD (Periapical Dental X-ray) dataset to build our SimCLR self-supervised ResNet-18 U-Net model, which generates the segmentation mask and then evaluates its quality. Our HUS-QA checks the segmentation mask quality without a ground-truth mask. Prediction confidence, edge sharpness, shape connectivity, and area-size penalty are the simple indicators considered in this research. Results show that standard confidence methods fail (r = -0.1394, p = 1.7864e-3, ROC AUC = 0.4275). By contrast, our HUS-QA shows a positive correlation with actual Dice scores (r = 0.4647, p = 3.7510e-28) and achieves a strong ROC-AUC of 0.8405. Therefore, HUS-QA serves as a practical tool for clinical quality control.

title: NECA: Neighbor Event Curve Augmentation for Multi-Horizon ICU Deterioration Prediction
zh_title: NECA：用于多时间窗ICU恶化预测的近邻事件曲线增强
summary: 提出模型无关方法，检索早期特征相似的历史患者，将其器官功能障碍发生时间转为累积事件曲线特征，用于多时间窗风险预测。
key_points: 检索相似早期窗口的训练集患者
生成6/12/24/42小时累积事件曲线特征
与下游标准预测器拼接使用
reason: 预印本，公开数据集验证，增量方法，无外部临床验证
abstract: Early prediction of ICU organ dysfunction events supports timely clinical monitoring and intervention, but estimating short-term organ-specific risk from early ICU records remains challenging due to irregular measurements, heterogeneous clinical variables, and the need to predict risk across multiple future horizons. Existing supervised models usually treat each patient as an isolated sample and do not explicitly use the observed event timing of similar historical patients. We propose Neighbor Event-Curve Augmentation (NECA), a model-agnostic method that retrieves training-set patients with similar early-window profiles and converts their subsequent organ dysfunction event onset times into cumulative event-curve features over 6h, 12h, 24h, and 42h. These features are concatenated with the original patient representation and used by standard downstream predictors. On PhysioNet 2012 and a 4,000-stay MIMIC-IV subset, NECA improves average PR-AUC and ROC-AUC across four organ dysfunction event tasks and seven supervised learners. The largest gain appears for neurological dysfunction events, where task-level average PR-AUC increases from 0.461 to 0.557 on PhysioNet 2012. Ablations show that clinically meaningful retrieval and horizon-specific neighbor risk drive most of the improvement, while the full cumulative curve adds task-dependent temporal context. These results support similar-patient event timing as a structured temporal risk signal for ICU organ dysfunction event prediction. The source code will be publicly released upon acceptance of this paper.
zh_abstract: ICU器官功能障碍事件的早期预测有助于及时的临床监测和干预，但由于测量不规则、临床变量异质，且需要预测未来多个时间范围内的风险，根据ICU早期记录估计短期器官特异性风险仍具挑战。现有的监督模型通常将每位患者视为孤立样本，未明确利用相似历史患者的已观察事件发生时间。我们提出邻居事件曲线增强（Neighbor Event-Curve Augmentation，NECA），这是一种与模型无关的方法：它检索训练集中早期窗口特征相似的患者，并将其后续器官功能障碍事件的发生时间转换为6小时、12小时、24小时和42小时的累积事件曲线特征。这些特征与原始患者表示拼接后，供标准下游预测器使用。在 PhysioNet 2012 和一个包含4,000次住院的 MIMIC-IV 子集上，NECA 在四项器官功能障碍事件任务和七种监督学习器上提高了平均 PR-AUC 和 ROC-AUC。最大的提升出现在神经系统功能障碍事件上，在 PhysioNet 2012 上其任务级平均 PR-AUC 从0.461升至0.557。消融实验表明，具有临床意义的检索以及特定时间范围的邻居风险带来了大部分改进，而完整的累积曲线则提供了依赖于任务的时间背景信息。这些结果支持将相似患者的事件发生时间作为ICU器官功能障碍事件预测的结构化时间风险信号。源代码将在本文被接受后公开发布。

title: Navigating the Eukaryotic Paradox: Insights for AI-Driven Computational Strategies Against Antifungal Resistance.
zh_title: 应对真核生物悖论：AI驱动计算策略对抗抗真菌耐药
summary: 综述评析AI/机器学习驱动的药物重定位在抗真菌治疗中的作用，并讨论真菌与人类宿主高度同源带来的结构与计算障碍。
key_points: 聚焦侵袭性真菌感染与抗真菌耐药
比较细菌、病毒与真菌的结构屏障和计算失败模式
将AI药物重定位视为de novo发现的快速替代
reason: 综述类文章，泛论为主，无新数据，属增量档
abstract: [Microorganisms] The escalating crisis of invasive fungal infections and increasing antifungal resistance demand rapid therapeutic innovation. Given the critically narrow clinical arsenal, artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) have emerged as pivotal strategies to accelerate drug repurposing, providing a rapid alternative to de novo drug discovery. However, translational success in medical mycology faces a major biological hurdle: the "eukaryotic paradox," the extensive genomic, metabolic, and structural homology between fungal cells and human hosts. This review provides a critical and comparative analysis of AI-driven drug repurposing as a therapeutic strategy. This review characterizes the hierarchies of structural barriers, biophysical transport bottlenecks, and computational failure modes across bacterial, viral, and fungal pathogens to explain why medical mycology remains one of the most difficult frontiers in computational pharmacology. It reviews limitations of fungal cell walls, biofilm EPS matrices, morphologic dynamic dimorphism, and scarcity of high-resolution 3D protein structures for AI models. Next-generation computational approaches and experimental platforms, ranging from physics-informed neural networks and transcriptomic profiling to microfluidic organ-on-a-chip validation systems, are also described to overcome these resistance mechanisms. Finally, this review emphasizes the importance of the development of tailored, physics-informed AI paradigms for effective therapeutic strategies against emerging resistant fungal pathogens.
zh_abstract: [微生物] 侵袭性真菌感染危机不断加剧，抗真菌耐药性日益增加，亟需快速的治疗创新。鉴于临床可用药物极为有限，人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）已成为加速药物重定位的关键策略，为从头药物发现提供了一种快速的替代途径。然而，医学真菌学领域的转化成功面临一项重大生物学障碍：“真核生物悖论”，即真菌细胞与人类宿主之间在基因组、代谢和结构上存在广泛的同源性。本综述对AI驱动的药物重定位这一治疗策略进行了批判性的比较分析。本综述刻画了细菌、病毒和真菌病原体中结构屏障的层级、生物物理转运瓶颈以及计算失败模式，以解释为何医学真菌学仍是计算药理学中最困难的前沿领域之一。本文回顾了真菌细胞壁、生物膜胞外聚合物（EPS）基质、形态动态二态性以及AI模型所需的高分辨率三维蛋白结构稀缺等方面的局限。此外，本文还介绍了旨在克服这些耐药机制的新一代计算方法和实验平台，范围从物理信息神经网络和转录组谱分析，到微流控器官芯片验证系统。最后，本综述强调，开发有针对性的、物理信息驱动的AI范式，对于制定针对新发耐药真菌病原体的有效治疗策略具有重要意义。

title: Artificial Intelligence for Cardiac Ischemia Detection: A Review of Biosensor, Biomarker, and Imaging Applications.

abstract: [Sensors (Basel, Switzerland)] Ischemic heart disease is the leading cause of global mortality, yet accurate and timely detection remains constrained by incomplete signal capture, noise, operator dependence, and imperfect reference standards. Artificial intelligence (AI) may enhance cardiovascular sensing by extracting latent diagnostic information from routinely acquired signals. This narrative review examines AI-enabled approaches to ischemia detection across three sensing modalities: the electrocardiogram as a bioelectric sensor, cardiac troponin as a biochemical marker, and cardiac imaging technologies (echocardiography, computed tomography, magnetic resonance, and nuclear imaging) as structural and functional sensors. For each modality, we evaluate the sensing pipeline, the reference standards, the endpoint actually measured (from acute coronary occlusion to functional ischemia), and reported performance metrics, separating diagnostic accuracy from effects on clinical workflow, patient outcomes, and cost. We also discuss emerging directions, including foundation models and multimodal fusion, together with translational challenges such as limited prospective validation, regulatory hurdles, and uncertain cost-effectiveness. Most evidence comes from retrospective, frequently single-center studies of diagnostic performance; few studies have measured effects on workflow, and fewer still on patient outcomes or cost. Routine clinical adoption will require prospective multicenter trials, standardized performance benchmarks, and evidence of clinical and economic benefit.
zh_abstract: [Sensors (Basel, Switzerland)] 缺血性心脏病是全球死亡的首要原因，但准确、及时的检测仍受到信号采集不完整、噪声、操作者依赖以及参考标准不完善的限制。人工智能（AI）可能通过从常规采集的信号中提取潜在的诊断信息来增强心血管传感。本叙述性综述考察了三种传感模式下基于 AI 的缺血检测方法：作为生物电传感器的心电图、作为生化标志物的心肌肌钙蛋白，以及作为结构和功能传感器的心脏成像技术（超声心动图、计算机断层扫描、磁共振和核成像）。针对每种模式，我们评估了传感流程、参考标准、实际测量的终点（从急性冠状动脉闭塞到功能性缺血）以及已报告的性能指标，并将诊断准确性与对临床工作流程、患者结局和成本的影响区分开来。我们还讨论了新兴方向，包括基础模型和多模态融合，以及转化方面的挑战，如前瞻性验证有限、监管障碍和成本效益不确定。大多数证据来自回顾性、常为单中心的诊断性能研究；很少有研究衡量对工作流程的影响，而衡量对患者结局或成本影响的研究更少。常规临床应用将需要前瞻性多中心试验、标准化的性能基准，以及临床和经济获益的证据。

abstract: [Journal of applied clinical medical physics] Workforce shortages and increasing clinical demands in Radiation Oncology and Medical Physics present challenges for maintaining high-quality residency training. This work presents a conceptual framework to evaluate the potential role of artificial intelligence (AI) in improving efficiency, scalability, and quality of residency education. Current teaching and learning modalities were categorized, and their relative contributions to training were estimated. Potential AI applications were mapped to these modalities, and the proportion of training that could be supported by AI was assessed. A simple conceptual model incorporating training time, AI-deliverable components (i.e., those potentially supported through direct interaction with AI systems), and dependence on direct human teaching was used to illustrate the potential impact on instructional effort. The potential effect of AI on educational quality was qualitatively evaluated, as well as limitations of AI for routine educational integration. AI applications were identified across multiple domains, including workflow-integrated feedback, simulation-based training, adaptive learning, and automated assessment. The largest potential impact was estimated in workflow-integrated, simulation-based, and self-directed learning environments. While reductions in direct human teaching effort were estimated to be modest, AI-enabled approaches were estimated to achieve substantial improvements in training quality, including increased feedback frequency, enhanced support for deliberate practice, and greater exposure to rare or high-risk scenarios. AI has the potential to enhance residency training by improving consistency, scalability, and educational quality. In the context of workforce constraints, the primary benefit of AI may be to augment training efficiency and reduce reliance on limited faculty resources while preserving the essential role of clinical experience.

title: Segment Anything Model Based Context Guided Mamba Unet for Medical Image Segmentation

abstract: Medical image segmentation is crucial for clinical diagnosis and treatment planning, requiring both global contextual understanding and fine-grained structural precision. While the Segment Anything Model (SAM) demonstrates strong generalization capabilities, its direct application to medical images often lacks domain-specific adaptability. Meanwhile, State Space Models (SSMs)-based methods, such as Mamba, efficiently capture long-range dependencies but may struggle with preserving fine anatomical details. To address these challenges, we propose a segment anything model based context guided mamba unet, SAMBA-UNet, a novel framework that integrates SAM's context knowledge with Mamba's hierarchical feature learning to enhance both global representation and local detail refinement. Specifically, we introduce the Hierarchical Context Enhancement Module (HCEM), an attention-based fusion module that deeply incorporates the multi-level features of SAM and Mamba to improve detail perception and segmentation precision. Additionally, we employ LoRA and Adapter-based fine-tuning to adapt SAM to medical imaging tasks, further enhancing its domain-specific segmentation capability and robustness. We conducted a comprehensive study on several medical segmentation datasets, including Synapse, ISIC17, and ISIC18, evaluating our method across multiple metrics. Experimental results demonstrate that SAMBA-UNet achieves state-of-the-art performance, effectively balancing generalization, segmentation accuracy, and computational efficiency. Our code will be released upon acceptance.
zh_abstract: 医学图像分割对临床诊断和治疗规划至关重要，既需要全局上下文理解，也需要精细的结构精度。尽管Segment Anything Model（SAM）展现出强大的泛化能力，但将其直接应用于医学图像时往往缺乏针对特定领域的适应性。与此同时，基于状态空间模型（SSMs）的方法（如Mamba）能够高效捕获长程依赖关系，但在保留精细解剖细节方面可能存在不足。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种基于Segment Anything Model的上下文引导Mamba UNet——SAMBA-UNet，这是一种新颖的框架，它将SAM的上下文知识与Mamba的层级特征学习相结合，以同时增强全局表征和局部细节精细化。具体而言，我们引入了层级上下文增强模块（Hierarchical Context Enhancement Module，HCEM），这是一种基于注意力的融合模块，可深度整合SAM与Mamba的多层级特征，以提升细节感知和分割精度。此外，我们采用基于LoRA和Adapter的微调方法使SAM适应医学成像任务，进一步增强其针对特定领域的分割能力和鲁棒性。我们在包括Synapse、ISIC17和ISIC18在内的多个医学分割数据集上开展了全面研究，并使用多种指标对我们的方法进行了评估。实验结果表明，SAMBA-UNet达到了最先进的性能，有效平衡了泛化能力、分割准确性和计算效率。我们的代码将在论文被接收后发布。

zh_title: 美国健康AI教育课程中的数据溯源与伦理覆盖情况
summary: 预印本横断面分析美国高校健康AI教育项目公开课程，评估数据溯源、伦理与可持续性内容的覆盖情况。

abstract: Failures of deployed clinical artificial intelligence (AI) systems have often originated in how their training data were generated. Whether the programs that train the health AI workforce teach practitioners to examine data provenance is unknown. We conducted a cross-sectional analysis of the publicly advertised curricula of health AI education programs at U.S. universities, identified through a structured multisource web search between April and July 2026. Two investigators coded coverage of data provenance (structural, dataset limitations, or data management only), ethics, and sustainability; collaborative structure; technical prerequisites; and the disciplinary background and gender of named instructors. The primary outcome was provenance coverage at the structural or dataset-limitations level. Of 43 candidate entries, 36 programs at 25 institutional units in 21 universities were included. Ethics was covered by 29 programs (80.6%; 95% confidence interval [CI], 65.0 to 90.2), data provenance by 8 (22.2%; 95% CI, 11.7 to 38.1), and structural provenance by 6 (16.7%; 95% CI, 7.9 to 31.9). None of the seven master's degree programs met the primary outcome, and no program addressed sustainability. Eighteen programs included team-based work, but only 5 assembled teams across clinical and technical backgrounds. Of 92 named instructors, 76.1% came from computational disciplines and 3.3% from the social sciences or humanities; among the 51 whose gender could be determined, 66.7% were men. U.S. health AI education programs widely taught ethics but rarely taught how clinical data are produced. None addressed the environmental cost of computation, and most instructors came from computational disciplines.

title: Fisher Contrastive Learning to Mitigate Feature Suppression: A Case Study in Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia Diagnosis
zh_title: Fisher对比学习缓解特征抑制：以急性早幼粒细胞白血病诊断为例
summary: 提出基于正则化Fisher迹准则的对比学习方法FCL，缓解特征抑制，并在模拟基准和APL诊断生物医学应用中验证。

abstract: Self-supervised contrastive learning (SSCL) learns representations by contrasting augmented views of the same sample, but it can exhibit feature suppression, where dominant or easy-to-learn factors suppress other class-relevant signals, degrading the performance of representations, particularly in high-dimensional data with heterogeneous features. We introduce Fisher Contrastive Learning (FCL), which uses a regularized Fisher trace criterion to address feature suppression. FCL learns embeddings by maximizing the discriminative strength of Fisher discriminant functions, producing representations that preserve class-relevant information implied by the augmentation process. We prove that the representations learned by FCL could alleviate the feature suppression effects. We demonstrate FCL on simulated benchmarks designed to induce feature suppression and on a real-world biomedical application, pretraining on large white blood cell microscopy image dataset and transfer learning for diagnosis of acute promyelocytic leukemia in an external cohort. In all experiments, FCL outperforms the self-supervised baselines and yields more robust and discriminative representations.
zh_abstract: 自监督对比学习（self-supervised contrastive learning，SSCL）通过对比同一样本的增强视图来学习表征，但可能出现特征抑制现象，即占主导地位或易于学习的因素抑制其他与类别相关的信号，从而降低表征的性能，在具有异质性特征的高维数据中尤为明显。我们提出费希尔对比学习（Fisher Contrastive Learning，FCL），其采用正则化的费希尔迹准则来解决特征抑制问题。FCL 通过最大化费希尔判别函数的判别强度来学习嵌入，从而得到能够保留增强过程所隐含的类别相关信息的表征。我们证明了 FCL 所学习的表征能够缓解特征抑制效应。我们在为诱发特征抑制而设计的模拟基准以及一个真实世界生物医学应用中对 FCL 进行了验证：即在大型白细胞显微图像数据集上进行预训练，并通过迁移学习在外部队列中诊断急性早幼粒细胞白血病。在所有实验中，FCL 均优于自监督基线方法，并产生更稳健、更具判别力的表征。

title: Anatomical Prior-Guided Routing for 3D Lung Tumor Segmentation

abstract: Accurate lung tumor segmentation in computed tomography (CT) is essential for treatment planning, response assessment, and quantitative imaging analysis. However, 3D lung tumor segmentation remains challenging because tumors occupy only a small portion of the whole volume and exhibit heterogeneous appearances across anatomical locations. In patch-based training and sliding-window inference for 3D medical image segmentation, location-dependent heterogeneity is further amplified because cropped image patches provide limited global anatomical context, making it difficult for a model to adapt its feature processing according to the anatomical region from which each patch is extracted. To address this limitation, we propose an Anatomical Prior-guided Routing Module (APRM) for lung tumor segmentation. For each image patch, we obtain anatomical prior information of regional occupancy and deterministically select an anatomical routing gate. The selected gate then performs sparse feature routing over a shared expert adapter pool, enabling anatomy-specific feature adaptation while sharing expert capacity across regions. We evaluate APRM on two datasets with various backbone networks and demonstrate consistent improvements over baseline models. Furthermore, feature visualizations show that APRM produces different feature responses depending on patch location, indicating that the proposed routing mechanism effectively adapts feature processing according to anatomical context.
zh_abstract: 在计算机断层扫描（CT）中准确分割肺部肿瘤对于治疗规划、疗效评估和定量影像分析至关重要。然而，三维肺部肿瘤分割仍具有挑战性，因为肿瘤仅占整个体积的一小部分，且在不同解剖位置表现出异质性的外观。在三维医学图像分割的基于图像块（patch）的训练和滑动窗口推理中，由于裁剪的图像块提供的全局解剖背景有限，位置相关的异质性被进一步放大，使模型难以根据每个图像块所处的解剖区域来调整其特征处理。为解决这一局限，我们提出一种用于肺部肿瘤分割的解剖先验引导路由模块（Anatomical Prior-guided Routing Module，APRM）。对于每个图像块，我们获取区域占据的解剖先验信息，并确定性地选择一个解剖路由门。随后，所选门在共享的专家适配器池上执行稀疏特征路由，从而在跨区域共享专家容量的同时实现解剖特异性的特征适应。我们在两个数据集上使用多种骨干网络评估 APRM，结果显示其相对基线模型取得一致的提升。此外，特征可视化表明 APRM 会依据图像块位置产生不同的特征响应，说明所提出的路由机制能够有效地根据解剖背景调整特征处理。

title: What Makes Medical Examination Items Difficult? Using Large Language Models to Explore Patterns Associated With Empirical Item Difficulty

abstract: Research on medical item difficulty has largely focused on prediction rather than on identifying interpretable patterns associated with empirical difficulty. This study used empirical difficulty labels to guide large language models (LLMs) in inducing difficulty rubrics and examined how rubric guidance affected LLM difficulty judgments. Using training items and their empirical difficulty estimates from the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) and the Physician Assistant National Certifying Examination (PANCE), Claude Opus 5 induced separate rubrics for absolute and pairwise difficulty judgment. None of the induced rubrics treated surface features, such as stem length, option count, or images, as major sources of difficulty. Several patterns emerged across both examinations, including cue convergence, misleading cues, and option competition, although their specific forms differed. Retrieval of knowledge that could not be derived from the stem was particularly prominent in the PANCE rubrics, whereas the USMLE rubrics placed greater emphasis on integrating multiple clinical cues. We compared commercial and open-weight LLMs on held-out items under unguided and rubric-guided conditions. Rubric guidance changed how models used the difficulty scale but did not consistently improve performance. In absolute judgments, guidance encouraged broader use of the scale and generally improved coarse-grained agreement, without consistently improving rank ordering. In pairwise comparisons, its effects varied across models and examinations, and judgments became more sensitive to presentation order. These findings suggest that the value of label-guided rubric induction may lie more in generating interpretable, testable hypotheses from empirical difficulty data than in reliably improving difficulty judgments.
zh_abstract: 关于医学试题难度的研究大多集中于预测，而非识别与实证难度相关的可解释模式。本研究利用实证难度标签引导大语言模型（LLM）归纳难度评分细则（rubric），并考察评分细则引导如何影响LLM的难度判断。利用美国医师执照考试（USMLE）和医师助理国家认证考试（PANCE）的训练题目及其实证难度估计值，Claude Opus 5分别为绝对难度判断和两两难度判断归纳出独立的评分细则。所有归纳出的评分细则均未将题干长度、选项数量或图像等表面特征视为难度的主要来源。两项考试中均出现了若干共同模式，包括线索汇聚、误导性线索和选项竞争，尽管其具体形式有所不同。无法从题干推导出的知识的提取在PANCE评分细则中尤为突出，而USMLE评分细则则更强调对多个临床线索的整合。我们在保留题目上，比较了商业和开放权重LLM在无引导和评分细则引导条件下的表现。评分细则引导改变了模型使用难度量表的方式，但并未一致地提升表现。在绝对判断中，引导促使模型更广泛地使用量表，并总体上改善了粗粒度的一致性，但未一致地改善排序。在两两比较中，其效果因模型和考试而异，且判断对呈现顺序变得更加敏感。这些发现提示，标签引导的评分细则归纳的价值可能更在于从实证难度数据中产生可解释、可检验的假设，而非可靠地提升难度判断。

title: Guidance-Coupled Nullspace Drifting for One-Step Medical Image Reconstruction
zh_title: 引导耦合零空间漂移的一步式医学图像重建
summary: 提出DriftRecon，在成像算子零空间中建模分布漂移，实现一步采样的生成式医学图像重建，避免迭代采样带来的高推理成本。

abstract: Generative reconstruction can recover high-quality images from undersampled acquisitions, but state-of-the-art generative priors commonly rely on iterative sampling. Reducing the number of iterations lowers inference cost but also removes opportunities for progressive distributional refinement, making it difficult to retain image realism without sacrificing reconstruction fidelity. Drift modeling offers an alternative by shifting progressive refinement to training, thereby enabling one-step sampling without an iterative inference trajectory. Existing drifting methods, however, do not account for the imaging operator when modeling distributional drift. We propose DriftRecon, a generative method for one-step medical image reconstruction that performs drifting directly in the nullspace of the imaging operator. DriftRecon uses nullspace-restricted noise to construct training samples and a multiscale generator that incorporates measurement conditioning across resolution levels, with its generated component projected onto the operator nullspace. To control the fidelity--realism trade-off at inference, a conditional guidance parameter continuously steers the same generator between measurement-conditioned and unconditional generation. We derive a guidance-dependent similarity-kernel temperature schedule that preserves the guidance-weighted mass receiving strengthened supervision, thereby progressively localizing drift interactions as guidance increases to limit the associated loss of reconstruction fidelity. Experiments in sparse-view CT and accelerated MRI reconstruction show that DriftRecon outperforms established generative reconstruction methods and recent drifting models while producing reconstructions in a single forward pass.

title: Open-Source Framework for the Visualization, Quantification, and Analysis of 4D Flow and High-Dimensional Magnetic Resonance Images

abstract: Background: Four-dimensional (4D) flow cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) captures 3D anatomy and blood velocity across the cardiac cycle, but current post-processing software is closed, varies across platforms, and sits outside open-source image-computing frameworks. We developed an open-source framework for the import, visualization, and quantification of 4D flow and other high-dimensional CMR within SlicerHeart, an extension for 3D Slicer. Methods: Import 4D Flow reads vendor DICOM, applies preprocessing, and stores velocities as a time-resolved vector field; Analyze 4D Flow provides measurement planes, streamline and Doppler-like visualization, segmentation propagation, and quantification. Underlying both, we extended the Insight Toolkit to store five- and higher-dimensional arrays. Flow quantification was compared with a commercial package (cvi42) and 2D phase contrast in 13 patients with congenital heart disease across 108 paired regions of interest (Bland-Altman analysis and intraclass correlation coefficients, ICCs). Consensus-recommended processing methods were also implemented as an open-source library with an automated test suite of analytic and CFD phantoms and clinical acquisitions. Results: The modules integrate with 3D Slicer's segmentation, registration, and rendering tools and export velocity fields and geometry for computational modeling. Agreement with cvi42 was close: forward volume bias -0.1 mL (95% limits of agreement 2.2 to -2.3; ICC 0.997), effective volume per minute bias -0.015 L/min (0.21 to -0.24; ICC 0.994). Against 2D phase contrast, forward volume bias (-2.2 mL) and mean absolute percentage error (21.8%) matched cvi42 (-2.1 mL; 21.3%). Conclusions: This open, extensible framework brings 4D flow CMR into an established image-computing ecosystem and agrees closely with a commercial reference; every step can be inspected, reproduced, and improved.
zh_abstract: 【背景】四维（4D）血流心血管磁共振（CMR）可捕获整个心动周期内的三维解剖结构和血流速度，但目前的后处理软件是封闭的，不同平台之间存在差异，且处于开源图像计算框架之外。我们在3D Slicer的扩展SlicerHeart中开发了一个开源框架，用于4D血流及其他高维CMR的导入、可视化和定量分析。【方法】Import 4D Flow模块读取厂商DICOM数据、进行预处理，并将速度以时间分辨向量场的形式存储；Analyze 4D Flow模块提供测量平面、流线和类多普勒可视化、分割传播及定量分析。在这两个模块之下，我们扩展了Insight Toolkit，使其能够存储五维及更高维数组。在13例先天性心脏病患者的108对配对感兴趣区中，将血流定量结果与商业软件包（cvi42）及二维相位对比进行了比较（Bland-Altman分析和组内相关系数，ICC）。此外，我们还将共识推荐的处理方法实现为开源库，并配有自动化测试套件，包含解析模型和CFD体模以及临床采集数据。【结果】这些模块与3D Slicer的分割、配准和渲染工具集成，并可导出速度场和几何结构用于计算建模。与cvi42的一致性良好：正向容积偏倚为-0.1 mL（95%一致性界限2.2至-2.3；ICC 0.997），每分钟有效容积偏倚为-0.015 L/min（0.21至-0.24；ICC 0.994）。与二维相位对比相比，正向容积偏倚（-2.2 mL）和平均绝对百分比误差（21.8%）与cvi42（-2.1 mL；21.3%）相当。【结论】该开放、可扩展的框架将4D血流CMR引入成熟的图像计算生态系统，并与商业参考软件高度一致；每一步均可检查、复现和改进。

title: Learning a Motion Manifold to Constrain Ambiguity in Unsupervised 4D Medical Image Interpolation
zh_title: 学习运动流形以约束无监督4D医学图像插值的歧义
summary: 提出学习运动流形的框架，约束无监督4D医学图像插值中的运动歧义，同时保留样本特异变化。
key_points: 跨样本谱基学习提取共有运动结构
样本条件Cayley基重定向
不增加可调运动变量数量
reason: 方法类预印本，摘要未见充分验证，属增量档
abstract: Unsupervised 4D medical image interpolation reconstructs intermediate anatomical states from temporally sparse observations without intermediate supervision. Distinct motion fields may attain comparable endpoint agreement while producing different intermediate anatomy, giving rise to motion ambiguity. This ambiguity is difficult to constrain when many independently adjustable motion variables must be estimated from the observed endpoints. We develop a framework that learns a motion manifold to restrict candidate motion fields while retaining sample-specific variation. Cross-Sample Spectral Basis Learning extracts recurring motion structure from endpoint-derived dense estimates and encodes it in a shared spectral basis. Sample-Conditioned Cayley Basis Reorientation uses predicted motion coordinates to rotate the effective motion directions for each endpoint pair without increasing the number of independent coordinates. Their composition defines a nonlinear family of complete velocity fields across endpoint pairs, accommodating anatomical and motion-state differences within a restricted representation. Integrating each predicted field supports bidirectional reconstruction at arbitrary intermediate times. Theoretical analysis establishes sufficient conditions under which endpoint observations distinguish nearby motions within the learned family. Experiments on ACDC and 4D-Lung demonstrate state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated methods trained without intermediate volumes and competitive results against methods using intermediate supervision.
zh_abstract: 无监督4D医学图像插值旨在无需中间帧监督的情况下，从时间上稀疏的观测中重建中间解剖状态。不同的运动场可能在端点处达到相当的一致性，却产生不同的中间解剖结构，由此产生运动歧义。当需要从观测到的端点估计许多可独立调节的运动变量时，这种歧义很难被约束。我们提出一个框架，学习一个运动流形以限制候选运动场，同时保留样本特异性变化。跨样本谱基学习（Cross-Sample Spectral Basis Learning）从由端点导出的稠密估计中提取反复出现的运动结构，并将其编码于共享的谱基中。样本条件化Cayley基重定向（Sample-Conditioned Cayley Basis Reorientation）利用预测的运动坐标，为每个端点对旋转有效运动方向，而不增加独立坐标的数量。二者的组合定义了跨端点对的完整速度场的非线性族，在受限表示内容纳解剖和运动状态的差异。对每个预测场进行积分，可支持在任意中间时刻的双向重建。理论分析给出了充分条件，在此条件下端点观测可区分所学族内邻近的运动。在ACDC和4D-Lung上的实验表明，在未使用中间体数据训练的被评估方法中，该方法达到了最先进的性能，并与使用中间监督的方法相比具有竞争力的结果。

title: Confidence Filtering in Video-Based Gait Assessment: Measurement Error versus Selection Shift
zh_title: 视频步态评估中的置信度过滤：测量误差与选择偏移
summary: 在帕金森相关队列(n=96)与NF2队列(n=18)中比较置信度筛选与随机筛选，发现置信度筛选会造成小幅运动摘要偏移。
key_points: 置信度筛选使运动摘要偏移约+0.05 SD
留出Mini-BESTest误差无明显变化
NF2队列无偏移，预测器未超过常数基线
reason: 小样本预印本，有方法学洞见但证据有限
abstract: Video-based gait assessment often keeps only high-confidence pose observations, which can lower measurement error but change the movement assessed. We compared confidence selection with budget-matched random selection in a Parkinson-related cohort (n = 96) and an NF2-related replication cohort (n = 18). In the Parkinson-related cohort, confidence selection produced a small but consistent shift in the observed movement summary (+0.05 SD, 95% CI 0.03 to 0.07), while held-out Mini-BESTest error stayed flat (-0.04 points, -0.13 to 0.05); a policy preserving motion-group proportions reduced the shift, while NF2 showed no shift and its predictor did not beat a constant baseline. Because this shift mixes measurement error with selection shift, we decompose and simulate both on the cohort's window structure. Filtering lowers local error when error depends on confidence, but biases the endpoint once confidence tracks movement more than error. In the Parkinson-related data, confidence was only weakly tied to movement (rho = 0.14). There, filtering is harmless if well-tracked windows are unbiased. If instead systematic error only redistributes within participants, filtering can add up to 0.58 degrees. Unchanged clinical error from such small-cohort predictors therefore cannot show that quality filtering preserves the assessed movement.
zh_abstract: 基于视频的步态评估常常仅保留高置信度的姿态观测，这可能降低测量误差，但会改变所评估的运动。我们在一个帕金森相关队列（n = 96）和一个NF2相关的复现队列（n = 18）中，比较了置信度选择与预算匹配的随机选择。在帕金森相关队列中，置信度选择使观察到的运动汇总指标产生小而一致的偏移（+0.05 SD，95% CI 0.03至0.07），而留出集Mini-BESTest误差保持不变（-0.04分，-0.13至0.05）；保持运动组比例的策略减小了该偏移，而NF2队列未见偏移，其预测器也未优于常数基线。由于这一偏移混合了测量误差与选择偏移，我们在该队列的窗口结构上对两者进行了分解和模拟。当误差取决于置信度时，过滤可降低局部误差，但一旦置信度与运动的关联强于与误差的关联，则会使终点产生偏倚。在帕金森相关数据中，置信度与运动仅弱相关（rho = 0.14）。在此情形下，若追踪良好的窗口无偏倚，则过滤无害；若系统误差仅在受试者内部重新分布，则过滤最多可增加0.58度。因此，来自此类小队列预测器的临床误差不变，并不能说明质量过滤保留了所评估的运动。

title: DOSE: Dominance-Guided Ordinal Severity Estimation from Sparse Relative Annotations
zh_title: DOSE：基于稀疏相对标注的优势引导有序严重度估计
summary: 提出仅用图像对严重度比较（无绝对标注）学习有序医学严重度的框架，通过全局比较图估计优势分数并设定嵌入空间累积间隔。
key_points: 仅用稀疏成对比较，无需绝对分级标注
比较图聚合得到每张图像的优势分数
分数差异决定嵌入空间的分离间隔
reason: 新方法预印本，摘要未见外部验证与临床结局，属增量档
abstract: Medical severity estimation commonly relies on absolute grade annotations, which are fundamentally ordinal, yet existing methods often treat the grades as independent categories. Learning-to-rank methods, which can be trained using relative annotations based on severity comparisons of image pairs, can provide continuous severity rankings but cannot directly predict discrete severity grades. We propose Dominance-guided Ordinal Severity Estimation from Sparse Relative Annotations (DOSE), a framework for learning ordinal medical severity from sparse pairwise comparisons without using absolute annotations. DOSE aggregates the observed comparisons through a global comparison graph to estimate a dominance score for each image. Differences between dominance scores set cumulative margins in the embedding space, so that pairs with larger estimated severity differences are separated more strongly, and also generate pseudo-pairs that supervise a scalar severity head alongside the observed comparisons. The learned continuous severity axis is converted into discrete grades via label-free score calibration, with tie-anchored segmentation as the main calibration method. In the experiment, DOSE consistently outperformed pairwise-ranking baselines on ACNE04, IDRiD, and LIMUC under different pair budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/TushirSahu/DOSE
zh_abstract: 医学严重程度估计通常依赖绝对分级标注，而这些分级本质上是有序的，但现有方法往往将各级视为相互独立的类别。基于图像对严重程度比较的相对标注即可训练的学习排序（learning-to-rank）方法，能够给出连续的严重程度排序，但无法直接预测离散的严重程度分级。我们提出了基于稀疏相对标注的主导性引导有序严重程度估计（Dominance-guided Ordinal Severity Estimation from Sparse Relative Annotations，DOSE），这是一个无需使用绝对标注、从稀疏成对比较中学习有序医学严重程度的框架。DOSE 通过全局比较图聚合已观察到的比较结果，为每幅图像估计一个主导性得分。主导性得分之间的差异在嵌入空间中设定累积间隔，使估计严重程度差异更大的图像对被更强地分开；同时还生成伪图像对，与已观察到的比较一起监督一个标量严重程度预测头。所学习到的连续严重程度轴通过无标签的得分校准转换为离散分级，其中以绑定锚定分段（tie-anchored segmentation）作为主要校准方法。实验中，在不同图像对预算下，DOSE 在 ACNE04、IDRiD 和 LIMUC 上始终优于成对排序基线方法。代码见 https://github.com/TushirSahu/DOSE

title: D-MOD: Diffusion mode estimation for accelerated MRI
zh_title: D-MOD：面向加速MRI的扩散模型后验众数估计
summary: 提出D-MOD算法，用预训练扩散模型经最小化-最大化迭代求后验众数而非随机采样，以降低加速MRI重建的计算成本；在fastMRI脑部数据上评估。
key_points: 以后验众数估计替代多次后验采样平均
结合去噪样本均值与k空间共轭梯度求解
在fastMRI脑部T1、T2、FLAIR上测试
reason: 预印本新方法，有一定新意，但摘要证据有限，属增量档
abstract: Diffusion models are powerful priors for accelerated MRI reconstruction, but most current methods are posterior samplers, which return a random draw from the posterior. A reproducible and high-quality reconstruction often requires averaging many samples, resulting in a high computational cost. We introduce D-MOD, a fast algorithm that instead provides a posterior mode. It uses a minorize-maximize algorithm on a lower bound of the smoothed log-posterior, which provably increases the objective. Each iteration draws S noisy samples of the current estimate at the current noise level, denoises them with a pretrained diffusion model, and combines their average with the measured k-space through a conjugate-gradient (CG) solve. We anneal the noise levels, as the distance between the bound and its target decays quadratically with noise. On fastMRI brain (T1, T2, FLAIR), a single D-MOD reconstruction exceeds, in PSNR, the 10-sample finite-MMSE estimates of DPS, DAPS and SNORE-P and stays within 0.31 dB of the strongest baselines (DiffPIR, DDS). This approach thus provides a fast deterministic reconstruction algorithm (11-73 times faster than MMSE estimates), which is useful in a clinical setting.
zh_abstract: 扩散模型是加速MRI重建的强大先验，但目前大多数方法是后验采样器，即返回后验分布中的一次随机抽样。要获得可重复且高质量的重建，往往需要对多个样本取平均，计算成本很高。我们提出了D-MOD，一种改为给出后验众数的快速算法。该算法在平滑对数后验的下界上使用minorize-maximize（极小化-极大化）算法，可证明能够使目标函数增大。每次迭代在当前噪声水平下对当前估计抽取S个含噪样本，用预训练扩散模型对其去噪，并将其平均值与实测k空间通过共轭梯度（CG）求解相结合。我们对噪声水平进行退火，因为下界与其目标之间的距离随噪声呈二次衰减。在fastMRI脑部数据（T1、T2、FLAIR）上，单次D-MOD重建的PSNR超过DPS、DAPS和SNORE-P的10样本有限MMSE估计，并与最强基线（DiffPIR、DDS）相差不超过0.31 dB。因此，该方法提供了一种快速的确定性重建算法（比MMSE估计快11-73倍），在临床环境中具有应用价值。

title: EPC-RawDC: Equivariant Physics Constrained 3D Diffusion with Raw Data Consistency for CBCT to CT Image Synthesis
zh_title: EPC-RawDC：物理约束等变3D扩散的CBCT到CT合成
summary: 提出条件3D潜在扩散框架，利用CBCT前向模型的几何等变投影约束和原始投影数据一致性，用于CBCT到CT图像合成，服务放疗场景。
key_points: 几何等变投影约束监督合成CT
利用单次扫描的原始投影数据做监督
基于3D潜在扩散的体积生成建模
reason: 预印本方法有新意，摘要无外部验证或临床结局，属增量档
abstract: Cone beam computed tomography (CBCT) is widely used for image guided and adaptive radiotherapy, but scatter, noise, reconstruction artifacts, and inaccurate Hounsfield units limit its quantitative use. Recent diffusion approaches for CBCT to CT synthesis remain largely image driven, with limited use of the underlying acquisition physics. We propose EPC-RawDC, a conditional 3D latent diffusion framework that combines volumetric generative modeling with two complementary constraints derived from the same scanner specific CBCT forward model. First, geometry equivariant projection constraint exploits the rotational equivariance of the CBCT forward operator by supervising the synthesized CT through correspondingly transformed reference projections. Second, raw data consistency uses noisy projection measurements of the individual acquisition as scan specific supervision during training. The framework was evaluated on two independent clinical cohorts with distinct scanner geometries and projection sources. For JUST, the physics constraints used measured clinical raw CBCT projections acquired with an Elekta system, whereas for SynthRAD2025 the projection data were simulated from the reference CT using a Varian geometry with Poisson photon statistics. EPC-RawDC achieved an SSIM of 0.97 in both cohorts and improved PSNR over DDPM by 2.66 dB on SynthRAD2025 and 2.10 dB on JUST, while reducing mean MAE by 20.3% and 19.0%, respectively. On SynthRAD2025, projection consistency and equivariant errors were reduced by 55.0% and 41.4% relative to DDPM. These results demonstrate that combining a volumetric diffusion prior with scanner geometry and scan specific projection measurements improves quantitative CBCT to CT synthesis across both simulated and measured projection domains. Code available after publication at https://github.com/ALZAHRAALTALIB/EPC-RawDC.
zh_abstract: 锥形束计算机断层扫描（CBCT）广泛用于影像引导放疗和自适应放疗，但散射、噪声、重建伪影以及亨氏单位不准确限制了其定量应用。近期用于CBCT到CT合成的扩散方法在很大程度上仍以图像为驱动，对底层采集物理的利用有限。我们提出EPC-RawDC，一种条件三维潜在扩散框架，将体积生成建模与源自同一扫描仪特定CBCT前向模型的两种互补约束相结合。第一，几何等变投影约束利用CBCT前向算子的旋转等变性，通过相应变换后的参考投影来监督合成CT。第二，原始数据一致性在训练中使用单次采集的含噪投影测量作为扫描特异性监督。该框架在两个具有不同扫描仪几何和投影来源的独立临床队列上进行了评估。对于JUST，物理约束使用Elekta系统采集的实测临床原始CBCT投影；对于SynthRAD2025，投影数据则采用Varian几何结构和泊松光子统计从参考CT模拟得到。EPC-RawDC在两个队列中的SSIM均为0.97，PSNR相比DDPM在SynthRAD2025上提高2.66 dB，在JUST上提高2.10 dB，平均MAE分别降低20.3%和19.0%。在SynthRAD2025上，投影一致性误差和等变性误差相对于DDPM分别降低55.0%和41.4%。这些结果表明，将体积扩散先验与扫描仪几何及扫描特异性投影测量相结合，可在模拟和实测投影域中改善CBCT到CT的定量合成。代码将在发表后发布于 https://github.com/ALZAHRAALTALIB/EPC-RawDC。

title: Protein co-scientist aided simulations of the structural and functional impact of O-GlcNAc Transferase TPR domain deletions and amino acid substitutions associated with X-Linked Intellectual Disability
zh_title: 蛋白质AI协同科学家辅助模拟OGT TPR结构域缺失与突变影响
summary: 预印本：整合Speak to a Protein（含Boltz-2、rDock）及AlphaFold3、HDOCK，模拟OGT的TPR结构域缺失和与X连锁智力障碍相关替换对结构与功能的影响。
key_points: 整合Boltz-2、rDock、AlphaFold3与HDOCK
研究TPR结构域缺失及疾病相关氨基酸替换
属计算模拟研究，来源未显示实验验证
reason: AI co-scientist用于蛋白质模拟，纯计算、证据有限，小幅加分
abstract: O-GlcNAc transferase (OGT) is an essential glycosyltransferase that regulates cellular processes through the addition of O-linked {beta}-N-acetyglucosamine (O-GlcNAc) to target proteins. Substrate recognition and protein-protein interactions are mediated by the tetratricopeptide repeat (TPR) domain, yet the contributions of individual TPR repeats to structural stability and function remain poorly understood. Here, we employed an integrated computational framework combining an AI protein co-scientist, Speak to a Protein, which incorporates Boltz-2 for structure prediction and rDock for ligand binding evaluation, with external tools including AlphaFold3 for more advanced structure prediction and the HDOCK server for protein-protein docking. This framework was used to investigate how deletions of TPR domains and disease-associated amino acid substitutions within the TPR domain affect OGT structure and function. Five synthetic truncation OGT isoforms, thirteen single-TPR deletion variants, and five X-linked intellectual disability (XLID)-associated amino acid substitutions were modeled and aligned to wild-type OGT for comparison. Structural perturbations were quantified using backbone root mean square deviation (RMSD), while functional effects were assessed through docking analyses with UDP-GlcNAc, Host Cell Factor 1 (HCF1), and Tet methylcytosine dioxygenase 1 (TET1). Variation in TPR length altered global protein structure and induced long-range conformational changes within the catalytic domain despite no sequence modifications in that region. Single TPR deletions showed that individual repeats contribute unequally to structural stability, with deletions in mid-to-late TPR domains producing the largest structural disruptions. Disease-associated amino acid substitutions also generated conformational changes and reduced predicted ligand binding, consistent with known reductions in enzymatic activity in XLID. Protein-protein docking analyses demonstrated substrate-specific effects, as domain deletion and amino acid substitution variants of OGT had different interactions with TET1 and HCF1. Collectively, these findings identify the TPR domain as a regulatory domain that governs structure, ligand recognition, and protein interactions. abstract: Background. Sequence-to-contact-map models are trained with pixel-wise losses, although the features of interest (insulation, domain boundaries, loops) are summaries of the map. Insulationbased losses help Hi-C resolution enhancement. No pre-specified test has asked whether they improve sequence-based prediction, judged against annotations independent of the training data. Proposed study. HiFold-Mamba predicts 448 x 448 maps at 2,048 bp from 1,048,576 bp of DNA on the DNALongBench contact-map task. Every component is reverse-complement-equivariant: convolutional tower, bidirectional Mamba blocks, multi-scale mixer and symmetric pairwise head. We pre-register three hypotheses: >> H1: it exceeds each of three trained baselines (reproduced Akita, a parameter-matched Transformer and a parameter-matched CNN) by [≥]0.01 stratum-adjusted correlation (SCC). >> H2: an insulation and boundary loss, computed from the predicted map with the operator used on the observed map, improves boundary AUROC and loop AP against independent 4DN boundary calls and ENCODE CTCF ChIA-PET loops, at equal training steps and without loss of SCC. >> H3: pretraining plus few-shot adaptation beats training from scratch on four held-out cell lines.Tests use a paired bootstrap over 237 one-megabase test blocks (one-sided = 0.025). Pilot data. >> Verification. The benchmark target, the window coordinates and the networks equivariance were verified. >> Locus-shared reference. Copying other cell lines measured maps at the same locus matches published Akita on the benchmarks SCC (0.227 vs. 0.230). >> SCC weightings. Two weightings in common use weight distance strata in opposite directions and agree only moderately ({rho} = 0.54). >> Comparison rule. In simulations calibrated on the pilot data, a per-block-best comparison against several baselines has no power. We therefore test against each baseline, which gives [≥] 90 % power at a true gain of 0.02 when between-model correlation is [≥] 0.95. >> H2 positive control. On validation windows, observed maps recover the independent boundaries (AUROC 0.61 - 0.91) and loops (0.86 - 0.90). This fixed the insulation window and showed that these annotations are largely shared across cell types.

【拟开展的研究】HiFold-Mamba 在 DNALongBench 接触图任务上，根据 1,048,576 bp 的 DNA 预测 2,048 bp 分辨率的 448 x 448 接触图。所有组件均具反向互补等变性：卷积塔、双向 Mamba 模块、多尺度混合器和对称的成对预测头。我们预先注册三个假设：>> H1：其表现超过三个经训练的基线模型（复现的 Akita、参数量匹配的 Transformer 和参数量匹配的 CNN）中的每一个，分层校正相关性（SCC）提高 [≥]0.01。>> H2：由预测图计算、并采用与观测图相同算子的绝缘性和边界损失，在相同训练步数且不降低 SCC 的情况下，可提高相对于独立的 4DN 边界识别结果和 ENCODE CTCF ChIA-PET 环的边界 AUROC 和环 AP。>> H3：预训练加少样本适应在四个留出的细胞系上优于从头训练。检验采用对 237 个 1 Mb 测试区块的配对自助法（单侧 = 0.025）。
【预试验数据】>> 验证：已验证基准目标、窗口坐标和网络的等变性。>> 位点共享参照：复制其他细胞系在同一位点测得的接触图，与已发表的 Akita 在该基准上的 SCC 相当（0.227 对 0.230）。>> SCC 加权：常用的两种加权方式对距离层的加权方向相反，仅中度一致（{rho} = 0.54）。>> 比较规则：在根据预试验数据校准的模拟中，对多个基线采用逐区块取最优的比较没有检验效能。因此我们对每个基线分别检验；当模型间相关性 [≥] 0.95 时，真实增益为 0.02 的情况下检验效能 [≥] 90%。>> H2 阳性对照：在验证窗口上，观测图能够还原独立的边界（AUROC 0.61 - 0.91）和环（0.86 - 0.90）。这确定了绝缘窗口，并表明这些注释在很大程度上为不同细胞类型所共有。

abstract: [Molecules (Basel, Switzerland)] Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly being applied in clinical laboratories to support laboratory processes and interpretation of test results. Recent developments in machine learning, deep learning, and large language models have expanded the potential applications of AI across different stages of laboratory testing. However, the use of AI in clinical laboratories also raises important questions regarding validation, analytical performance, and transferability between laboratories. This narrative review examines recent applications of AI across the total testing process in clinical chemistry. Recent English-language scientific literature published from 2023 to 18 August 2026 was identified through searches of PubMed, Scopus, and Google Scholar. It describes AI-assisted test utilization; specimen handling and quality assessment; detection of laboratory errors; patient-based quality control; interpretation of complex analytical outputs, including signals from emerging AI-integrated biosensors and nanomaterial-based analytical platforms; result verification; and laboratory-report interpretation. The review also discusses major implementation challenges, including analytical variability, data quality, sensor and platform reproducibility, model generalizability, interoperability, and limitations of large language models. Particular attention is given to external validation, transportability, and real-world implementation. Among the studies considered in this review, many applications remain supported mainly by retrospective or internally validated studies, while prospective and operational evaluations are less common. Finally, practical considerations for validation, local verification, quality assurance, and performance monitoring are discussed. AI has considerable potential to support clinical chemistry laboratories, but safe use requires appropriate evaluation and continued involvement of laboratory professionals.

abstract: [Microorganisms] Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) surveillance is increasingly strained by interconnected global crises, i.e., pandemics, climate change, armed conflicts, population mobility, and health inequalities, that disrupt healthcare delivery, diagnostic capacity, and laboratory infrastructure. In parallel, artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, whole-genome sequencing, metagenomics, and digital surveillance offer the potential to shift from reactive reporting to predictive intelligence that anticipates resistance threats, although current implementations remain sector-specific, retrospective, and project-funded. Environmental surveillance, particularly wastewater monitoring coupled with genomic epidemiology, provides early warnings at population and ecosystem levels. The future integration of AI across human, animal, and environmental sectors could enable unified One Health intelligence; no such integrated platform is currently operational. This review focuses primarily on bacterial AMR. It examines how global drivers strain surveillance, how genomic, metagenomic, digital, and AI-enabled technologies reshape AMR detection and prediction, and the emerging non-antibiotic therapeutic landscape, including bacteriophage therapy, Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats (CRISPR)-based antimicrobials, antimicrobial peptides, microbiota-directed interventions, nanomedicine, host-directed therapies, photodynamic therapy, and vaccines. It then explores how these innovations can be integrated within a One Health framework to support coordinated global preparedness. Addressing the AMR crisis will require not only technological innovation but also equitable implementation, interdisciplinary collaboration, and resilient systems.

abstract: [Pharmaceutics] Physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) modeling is now central to pediatric dose selection, because clinical sampling in children is ethically constrained and simple weight-based scaling is unreliable while organ function and enzyme activity are still maturing. Three bottlenecks limit classical PBPK in this setting, namely building physiologically coherent virtual patient populations, extrapolating drug disposition across species and age, and estimating many mechanism-linked parameters from sparse data. Over the past five years, deep learning has begun to address each. Generative models constrained by physiological knowledge create virtual patients that preserve realistic correlations and whole-body coherence. Graph networks and neural ordinary differential equations learn continuous scaling and maturation relationships instead of relying on fixed exponents. Physics-informed networks and surrogate emulators estimate mechanistic parameters and quantify uncertainty in data-poor pediatric settings. This review surveys these developments, organizes them by the PBPK workflow they serve, and links them to precision dosing of three antiepileptic drugs, lacosamide, lamotrigine, and oxcarbazepine. Unlike earlier surveys focused on concentration prediction and therapeutic drug monitoring, we keep the mechanistic model in the foreground, treating the virtual patient as the unit of simulation. We also discuss open problems, including validation standards for generated populations, the regulatory qualification of learning-enhanced PBPK, uncertainty reporting, and the prospect of foundation models of pharmacokinetics. Throughout, we distinguish methodological maturity from demonstrated clinical benefit.

abstract: Predictive models trained at well-resourced data-rich institutions often fail when deployed in new populations. Motivated by the goal of building clinical diagnosis and decision-making algorithms for data-scarce rural populations using the general knowledge learned from data-rich hospitals, we formulate the fundamental question of \emph{domain generalization with adversarially chosen domains}, which asks a learner to perform on any unseen target domain nearly as well as the worst hypothesis consistent with the evidence from the observed source domains. Assuming only that the hypothesis class contains a "universal" predictor with small error on all $k$ source domains, we characterize the sample complexity of this objective up to logarithmic factors. Letting $d$ denote the VC dimension of the hypothesis class, we find, somewhat surprisingly, that the sample complexity reduces significantly from $Ω(dk)$ to $O(d)$ under a small relaxation of the learning goal in which, roughly speaking, we allow the learned model to compete with hypotheses that perform well on 99% instead of 100% of the source domains. By applying this insight to the meta-distributional setting, in which source domains are selected according to a distribution on distributions, we obtain a corresponding improvement over known sample complexity upper bounds. We also study the effect of data access to the target domain and show that a small labeled sample from the target domain does not improve the worst-case sample complexity on the source domains.

abstract: [Nutrients] Precision nutrition increasingly combines functional foods, multi-omics, digital phenotyping, and artificial intelligence, yet the incremental decision value of additional data layers remains uncertain. This critical narrative review and hypothesis-generating conceptual proposal examines evidence on personalized nutrition, dynamic response phenotyping, functional-food heterogeneity, multi-omics integration, and AI-supported decisions. Personalized advice can improve dietary behavior and selected cardiometabolic outcomes, whereas the additional clinical benefit attributable specifically to elaborate molecular profiling has been inconsistent. Dynamic challenge studies suggest that response amplitude, timing, coordination, recovery, and conditional repeatability may provide information beyond static profiles, but reproducibility is required before these features can be treated as person-specific traits. The Allostatic Viability Principle (AVP) is proposed as a conceptual physiological and decision framework rather than a validated predictor or biomarker. Its intended contribution is to organize existing approaches around viable, context-appropriate regulation, proportional use of additional measurements, explicit uncertainty, an outcome hierarchy that does not equate molecular change with health benefit, and a response-and-revision loop. Whether this organization improves decisions or outcomes beyond high-quality conventional or adaptive personalized nutrition remains an empirical question. The framework is therefore presented as a testable structure for determining when additional individual-level information is reproducible, relevant, and sufficiently decision changing to justify use.

abstract: Assessment of the main pancreatic duct (MPD) from volumetric magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography (MRCP) scans is an essential task for ductal dilatation diagnosis and pancreatic cancer analysis. However, manual assessment is affected by reader variability in which automated analysis may assist. Nevertheless, fully automated and uncertainty-aware MPD analysis from volumetric MRCP remains underexplored area of research. In this study, we propose an automatic and uncertainty-aware deep learning-based pipeline for MPD segmentation and maximum-width analysis from MRCP scans. A coarse localisation model first identifies the ductal region-of-interest, followed by a fine model that segments the MPD within the region. The dataset consists of 256 MPD-segmented MRCP scans from 69 patients. A randomly selected holdout test subset of 14 patients with 55 MRCP volumes was used for evaluation. We employed a five-model cross-validation ensemble for improved performance and uncertainty estimation. The best MPD segmentation performance was 0.634 DSC, 0.744 precision, and 0.593 recall. The mean absolute error for maximum MPD width prediction was 0.355~mm and dilated MPD ($\geq 5$~mm) was detected with 75.0\% sensitivity and 74.4\% specificity. These novel results suggest that automated MPD segmentation can be used to aid MRCP-based duct measurements.
zh_abstract: 根据容积磁共振胰胆管成像（MRCP）扫描评估主胰管（MPD）是诊断胰管扩张和分析胰腺癌的一项重要任务。然而，人工评估受阅片者间差异的影响，自动化分析可能对此有所帮助。尽管如此，基于容积MRCP的全自动且具备不确定性感知的MPD分析仍是研究较少的领域。在本研究中，我们提出了一种基于深度学习的自动且具备不确定性感知的流程，用于从MRCP扫描中进行MPD分割和最大管径分析。首先由粗定位模型识别胰管感兴趣区域，随后由精细模型在该区域内分割MPD。数据集包含来自69例患者的256个已完成MPD分割的MRCP扫描。随机选取14例患者的55个MRCP容积作为留出测试子集用于评估。我们采用五模型交叉验证集成以提升性能并进行不确定性估计。最佳MPD分割性能为DSC 0.634、精确率0.744、召回率0.593。最大MPD管径预测的平均绝对误差为0.355 mm，扩张MPD（$\geq 5$ mm）的检出敏感性为75.0%，特异性为74.4%。这些新的结果提示，自动化MPD分割可用于辅助基于MRCP的胰管测量。

abstract: This study explores the role of hyperparameter optimization (HPO) in enhancing the detection of Atrial Fibrillation (AF) using both machine learning and deep learning models. We evaluated a range of standard classifiers - Decision Tree, Random Forest, and XGBoost classifiers, alongside deep learning architectures including Recurrent Neural Networks, Deep Neural Networks, and Siamese Neural Networks. To fine-tune these models, we applied four HPO methods: Genetic Algorithm, Hyperband, Optuna, and SMAC3. The experiments were conducted using inter-patient and intra- patient data splits to assess model generalization and robustness in the presence of class imbalance, which is reflective of real-world AF occurrence. Our results, based on PhysioNet electrocardiogram datasets, showed that the Hyperband-optimized XGBoost model outperformed all others, achieving a peak F1 score of 96.95%. These findings highlight the critical role of suitable HPO strategies in enhancing the accuracy and robustness of AF classification outcomes in clinical settings.
zh_abstract: 本研究探讨了超参数优化（HPO）在利用机器学习和深度学习模型提升心房颤动（AF）检测中的作用。我们评估了一系列标准分类器——决策树（Decision Tree）、随机森林（Random Forest）和XGBoost分类器，以及包括循环神经网络、深度神经网络和孪生神经网络在内的深度学习架构。为了对这些模型进行微调，我们应用了四种HPO方法：遗传算法、Hyperband、Optuna和SMAC3。实验采用患者间和患者内两种数据划分方式，以评估模型在类别不平衡（反映真实世界中AF的发生情况）条件下的泛化能力和鲁棒性。基于PhysioNet心电图数据集的结果显示，经Hyperband优化的XGBoost模型优于所有其他模型，F1分数峰值达到96.95%。这些发现凸显了合适的HPO策略对于提升临床环境中AF分类结果的准确性和鲁棒性具有关键作用。

title: Carrier-Limited Release Risk in Electrospun Nanofibers for Regenerative Endodontics: Constraint Discovery from 25 Formulations

abstract: Regenerative endodontics needs an intracanal carrier that keeps disinfecting across a dressing interval that clinicians schedule at one to four weeks, without harming the stem cells that rebuild the pulp. We ask what one completed 25-formulation electrospinning campaign of poly(vinylpyrrolidone) (PVP) fibers carrying metronidazole, ciprofloxacin, minocycline and Ca(OH)2 can decide, and use machine learning for constraint discovery and decision support rather than as a new predictor. After an audit against the source thesis, logistic regression predicts fine-fiber formation at 96% leave-one-out accuracy, but a one-threshold rule does as well, the gain over the 80% majority baseline is not significant (exact McNemar p = 0.125), and accuracy falls to 84% when mixture loading is encoded per component. Diameter models interpolate within formulation families (ridge MAE 193 nm, 95% CI 96 to 317 nm) and fail across them (R^2 < 0). Because the campaign never measured release, we assemble a same-drug, cross-carrier evidence table: 17 bounded metronidazole and ciprofloxacin observations from seven studies, with two-sided censoring. Water-soluble carriers (PVP, PVA) completed release within 80 h (PVP within 8 h); no water-insoluble monolithic carrier reached 90% within its observation window, releasing 1.5 to 50%; both within-study comparisons separate at matched loading; and blend, core-shell and thick-mat architectures released over 3 to 28 days. The PVP mats therefore carry a carrier-limited release risk, not a proven ceiling, and one dissolution experiment can confirm or overturn it. A censoring-aware screen keeps three necessarily and one possibly nondominated formulation, and fixed-budget replays show that uncertainty sampling finds failed formulations sooner, except the one it is confidently wrong about.
zh_abstract: 再生牙髓治疗需要一种根管内载体，能够在临床上安排的一至四周换药间隔内持续消毒，同时不损害重建牙髓的干细胞。我们探讨：一项已完成的、包含25种配方的聚乙烯吡咯烷酮（PVP）纤维静电纺丝实验（载有甲硝唑、环丙沙星、米诺环素和Ca(OH)2）能够说明什么，并将机器学习用于约束条件发现和决策支持，而非作为新的预测工具。在对照原始学位论文进行核查后，逻辑回归预测细纤维形成的留一法准确率为96%，但单一阈值规则也能达到同样水平，相对于80%多数类基线的提升不显著（精确McNemar检验 p = 0.125），且当按组分编码混合物载药量时准确率降至84%。直径模型可在配方家族内部插值（岭回归MAE为193 nm，95% CI 96至317 nm），但跨家族则失效（R^2 < 0）。由于该实验未测量释放，我们汇集了一个同药物、跨载体的证据表：来自七项研究的17个有界的甲硝唑和环丙沙星观测值，含双侧删失。水溶性载体（PVP、PVA）在80小时内完成释放（PVP在8小时内）；没有水不溶性的整体式载体在其观察窗口内达到90%，释放为1.5%至50%；两项研究内比较均在载药量匹配时显示分离；共混、核壳和厚垫结构的释放持续3至28天。因此，PVP纤维垫存在载体限制性的释放风险，但并非已证实的上限，一次溶出实验即可证实或推翻这一点。一项考虑删失的筛选保留了三种必然非劣和一种可能非劣的配方，固定预算回放显示，不确定性采样能更早发现失败的配方，但对其自信地判断错误的那一种除外。

title: Fox: Predicting rates of host-symbiont co-evolution events with association-aware attention
zh_title: Fox：关联感知注意力预测宿主-共生体共进化事件速率
summary: 提出Transformer架构Fox，直接从宿主与共生体序列比对及映射推断四类共系统发育事件的相对频率，无需建树或重构，基于模拟推断训练。
key_points: 直接输入宿主与共生体多序列比对
无需系统发育树重建或协调步骤
采用基于模拟的推断训练
reason: 预印本，演化生物学方法，与医疗关联弱，基于模拟训练，属增量档
abstract: Motivation: Hosts and their symbionts share a history of associations in which lineages cospeciate, switch hosts, duplicate, or are lost. Quantifying the relative frequencies of these four events is a central goal of cophylogenetics, but existing tools typically require a fully resolved, correctly rooted host tree, often alongside a symbiont tree, propagating tree-inference errors into the reconciliation and scaling poorly to large systems. Results: We introduce Fox, a transformer neural network architecture that infers the relative frequencies of the four cophylogenetic events directly from a pair of host and symbiont multiple sequence alignments (MSAs) and their sequence mapping, with no tree-reconstruction or reconciliation step. Fox is trained under a simulation-based inference scheme: it learns event frequencies from alignments generated by a coevolutionary process, paying its computational cost once at training time and processing any new system in a single forward pass. On held-out data from its training simulator, Fox recovers event frequencies accurately and with near-zero bias. On additional synthetic data from an independent cophylogeny simulator, its error roughly doubled, but is still very low allowing to track the true frequencies. Most importantly, when compared to the Approximate Bayesian Computation (ABC)-based method AmoCoala on these data, it reduces mean absolute error by 45-76% for cospeciations, host switches and duplications and shows similar error for losses, while running more than three orders of magnitude faster. Applied to the empirical cockroach-Blattabacterium system, Fox recovers the expected cospeciation-dominated profile, showing that behaviour learned on simulated data transfers to real sequences. These results confirm that the coevolutionary signal usually extracted from trees can be read directly, accurately, and fast in the alignments themselves
zh_abstract:
【动机】宿主及其共生体共享一段关联历史，在此过程中谱系会发生共物种形成（cospeciation）、宿主转换、复制或丢失。量化这四类事件的相对频率是共系统发育学（cophylogenetics）的核心目标，但现有工具通常需要一棵完全解析且根正确的宿主树，往往还需要一棵共生体树，这会将树推断的误差传递到协调（reconciliation）过程中，并且在大型系统中扩展性较差。
【结果】我们提出了 Fox，一种 Transformer 神经网络架构，可直接从一对宿主和共生体的多序列比对（MSA）及其序列映射中推断四类共系统发育事件的相对频率，无需树重建或协调步骤。Fox 采用基于模拟的推断方案进行训练：它从共进化过程生成的比对中学习事件频率，仅在训练时付出一次计算成本，并可在一次前向传播中处理任何新系统。在来自其训练模拟器的留出数据上，Fox 能够准确恢复事件频率，且偏差接近于零。在来自独立共系统发育模拟器的额外合成数据上，其误差大约增加了一倍，但仍然非常低，足以追踪真实频率。最重要的是，在这些数据上与基于近似贝叶斯计算（ABC）的方法 AmoCoala 相比，Fox 使共物种形成、宿主转换和复制的平均绝对误差降低了 45-76%，丢失事件的误差相近，同时运行速度快了三个以上数量级。应用于蟑螂-布氏菌属（Blattabacterium）这一实证系统时，Fox 恢复出了以共物种形成为主导的预期特征，表明在模拟数据上学到的行为可迁移到真实序列。这些结果证实，通常从树中提取的共进化信号可以直接、准确且快速地从比对本身中读取。

abstract: [Microorganisms] Microbial colony analysis is routinely used in clinical microbiology, pharmaceutical quality control, food safety, and environmental monitoring. Colony enumeration remains challenging because real-world plates frequently show crowding, size variation, background debris, and plate-rim interference. Low contrast on membrane or filter media, weak colony boundaries, and ultra-dense or too-numerous-to-count (TNTC) growth further complicate analysis. These conditions increase counting variability and limit rule-based counters. This review examines artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled colony analysis and links recurrent plate-reading challenges to method selection and validation requirements. We examine traditional threshold- and morphology-based pipelines, object detection, semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, and density- or keypoint-based estimation. Current evidence is stronger for plate-level triage and semi-quantitative interpretation than for direct colony enumeration. However, evidence supporting routine quantitative colony-forming unit (CFU) reporting across laboratories remains limited. Reliable deployment requires methods suited to plate format, organism, imaging conditions, and intended use, with validation in the target workflow.
